mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_record (application_id, approver_id, step, action, comment) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{approverId}, #{step}, #{action}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.real_name AS approver_name FROM approval_record r JOIN `user` u ON r.approver_id = u.id WHERE r.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY r.create_time ASC
